# ssp_services_status (Data Source)

Retrieves the status of individual platform service categories and the messaging service.

Corresponds to `GET /ssp/cluster/monitor/services/status`.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `data` (Attributes List) Status of each platform service category. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data))
- `messaging_service` (Attributes) Status and metrics of the platform messaging service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--messaging_service))

<a id="nestedatt--data"></a>

### Nested Schema for `data`

Read-Only:

- `health` (String) Health status of the service category.
- `service_name` (String) Name of the service category.

<a id="nestedatt--messaging_service"></a>

### Nested Schema for `messaging_service`

Read-Only:

- `status` (String) Health status of the messaging service.
